about: Offline regression data. Transcript text and the model's recorded opening answers captured from earlier live evaluation runs (legacy runs of calls 7-9, and unified runs with the generalized prompt). Used only to check how the CURRENT backend code treats those recorded answers; it says nothing about how a live model would answer today.

segments.text: Good afternoon. This is Prit Jhavikar calling from Shahah, Finley's regarding Mr. Karan Malhotra.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Am I speaking with someone from his office?

segments.speaker: borrower
segments.text: Yes, I am his colleague. May I know why are you calling?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am calling because Karan has an outstanding loan of 55,000 rupees to the company.

segments.speaker: borrower
segments.text: I am sorry but I don't handle his personal matter. You should speak to him directly.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: He has missed several payments. We haven't received the amount despite multiple reminders.

segments.speaker: borrower
segments.text: That's private information. Why are you sharing it with me?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Please ask him to contact Shahafinlees as soon as possible about his pending payments.
